veranderings.rede: One plucks (tokkel) a string in Afrikaans; 'trek' reads as pulling it.
A comma closes the embedded relative clause before the main verb, so the subject reads clearly.

veranderings.voor: slaan die vel met 'n stok en die groot vel
veranderings.na: slaan die vel met 'n stok, en die groot vel
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
veranderings.voor: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele van Zimbabwe
veranderings.na: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele in Zimbabwe
veranderings.rede: Avoids the repeated 'van ... van' chain; meaning unchanged.

veranderings.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
veranderings.rede: Two stacked attributive adjectives read more naturally with a comma than with 'en'.
'binne-in' is the natural form at the end of the phrase and matches the hosho block.

veranderings.voor: Die danser se eie voete skud hulle.
veranderings.na: Die danser se eie voete laat hulle skud.
veranderings.rede: As written, 'hulle' can be read as the subject shaking the feet; 'laat hulle skud' removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: Die klank is hoog en kort en dit val
veranderings.na: Die klank is hoog en kort, en dit val
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; also separates it from the list 'hoog en kort'.

veranderings.voor: Al die slaginstrumente saam is een familie
veranderings.na: Al die slaginstrumente saam vorm een familie
veranderings.rede: 'saam vorm' is more natural than 'saam is' for a group making up a family.
An instruction to listen for something is 'luister of' in Afrikaans; imperative 'hoor of' is unidiomatic.
Same as above: 'luister of', not imperative 'hoor of'.
'woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural preposition for words taken from the lesson.
'gedroog' is the simpler, more natural verb form than 'droog gemaak'.

veranderings.voor: so lank duur soos twee kwartnote
veranderings.na: so lank duur as twee kwartnote
veranderings.rede: The comparison of equality is 'so ... as' in Afrikaans, as the kwartnoot entry already has it; 'so ... soos' is wrong.

vlae.rede: Check the music term: Afrikaans usually speaks of 'n tweeslagmaat / vierslagmaat (or twee- of vierslagmaat); 'viermaatslag' may be a CAPS term, so not changed.

vlae.teks: Die instrumente in 'n familie is nie regtig familie van mekaar nie.
vlae.rede: 'familie van mekaar' is colloquial; 'aan mekaar verwant' is more standard but would lose the deliberate play on 'familie', so left for a person.
